text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Osaka Hai behind us,
Maruzensky is now
training harder than
ever.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I need to take a break. I've been
going
full steam ahead for too long.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's not like I've become super
serious about
training or anything...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm just having too much fun and can't
control
myself. My match with Rudolf
was so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So chillaxed! Everything's fine!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But there is something I'm a little concerned about...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she says this, I follow Maruzensky's
gaze to
find...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... pant... huff...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: One more!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: M-me, too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I know the Yasuda Kinen is coming up
soon, and
those two are trying their
best, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I have to help them out however I
can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, while I'm heading to
my room
after work...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh! Maruzensky's trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's Grass! Grass is in trouble!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: How does it look, doctor?

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
You'll be just fine. It looks like you
twisted it a
little.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whew! I'm glad it's not a major injury.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Indeed...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thank you for calling the school doctor!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for the trouble.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...We need to get faster, you know?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Watching Maruzensky and the student
council
president race right in front of us
was... It was
really amazing...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But it also made us realize just how far
we still
have to go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems that they're pushing themselves
too hard
in a rush to catch up to
Maruzensky and Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: We're very aware of that, but still...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder and Special Week's
expressions
tell me that they aren't
going to stop.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear that they lack a very important
detail.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Grass! Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
M-Maruzensky! Did you come all the
way from
home?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My trainer called and told me what
happened!
How is your injury?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My trainer called and told me what
happened!
How is your injury?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder explains her condition
and the
circumstances that led up to it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So you got impatient, huh...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you're trying so hard. Having
strong
rivals fires me up too...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But you guys seem to be missing
something
important right now.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What is it? Tell us, please.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you exactly what I mean, so
come hang
out with me for a minute.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Um, Maruzensky, when you say we're
missing
something...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You guys watched me and Rudolf race,
and felt
that you couldn't match up,
right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Did you feel anything else?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Like... what?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I had the best time racing with Rudolf!
We both
lost ourselves in the race,
fighting with everything
we had...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Without saying a word, we both knew
we were
having such a blast that we
didn't want the race
to end!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's that enjoyment that always pushes
me to go
faster.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I want to run faster because it feels
good. I want
to win races because it's
fun.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Right now, you guys are in such a hurry
to get
better, you're forgetting to have
fun.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And that means, if we raced now, I'm
sure I'd win.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember the feeling of
watching me,
with excitement gleaming
in your eyes?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You both said you would chase after me
and kept
running happily every day...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I know that you both still have that joy
for
running.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I have been pushing myself hard lately, forcing myself to run until I can barely even stand...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Grass! Once your leg feels better, let's
run and
time each other again!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's be happy getting faster bit by bit,
just like
we used to!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So... having fun is what pushes you
forward. I
guess it's true what they say,
"What you like you
will do well."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Instead of being impatient to catch up,
we should
enjoy the chase...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Thinking about it that way makes
me want
to get out there and run right
now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Yeah, I can't wait to get back to
training!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I could be of help!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And thank you for calling me here,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And thank you for calling me here,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to keep trying my best to be a
reliable
big sister to my adorable
schoolmates!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Maruzensky, why did you
bring us
here?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Isn't it obvious? There's no better
place to
embrace your youth than
outdoors, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! Pump your fist in the air and sing
the
words, "Don't you... forget about
me!" ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I see! Okay, here I go... Don't you...
forget me!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Um... I'll remember you...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the younger students get back
on track
and resume their training for
the Yasuda Kinen in
high spirits.
